selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent rules accept 10.100.94.11/32 on TCP/9000 before rejecting every other source; firewalld remains enabled and running after restart.
The public zone permits SSH, port 22 listens on IPv4 and IPv6, and both node2 and node3 reached node1’s SSH authentication stage.
With a confirmed listener on node1:9000, node2 received HTTP 200 after all node restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: The source-independent catch-all reject rule is active and permanent; node3’s direct attempt returned HTTP 000 and connection failure.
Baseline boot ID aad96cc9…; reboot acknowledged; recovered with boot ID 74488e0e…; SSH, firewalld, rules, and intended TCP/9000 behavior recovered.
Baseline boot ID e625b9a5…; reboot acknowledged; recovered with boot ID a355a70e… and healthy SSH, firewalld, address, and node1 network path.
Baseline boot ID 180a78a0…; reboot acknowledged; recovered with boot ID aabcc470… and healthy SSH, firewalld, address, and node1 network path.
